profiles.name: Elizabeth Murray
profiles.description:
Elizabeth Murray is an anti-nuclear activist and retired CIA media analyst associated with the Ground Zero Center for Nonviolent Action and the Pacific Life Community.

On March 5, 2025, she and John Heid were arrested for a nonviolent prayer protest on Raytheon property in Tucson, Arizona, opposing nuclear-weapons production. They represented themselves at a September 2 bench trial before Judge Robert Forman in Pima County Consolidated Justice Court. After written guilty verdicts for third-degree criminal trespass, they were sentenced on October 27, 2025, to twenty hours of community service each. Murray described the outcome in the Ground Zero newsletter. The documented sentence was community service, not imprisonment; the available accounts do not establish a multi-day jail stay for this action.
profiles.finding: Ground Zero Jan2023 and Oct2025 newsletters identify CIA analyst and named group photographs. Artist/memoirist namesakes rejected. Named-photo extraction and crop verification remain open.
profiles.rights: No image accepted; no public-domain assumption.

profiles.name: Toby Blomé
profiles.description: Toby Blomé is a retired physical therapist, former teacher, and organizer with San Francisco CODEPINK. She began organizing the annual Creech Air Force Base drone protests in 2009, started recurring protests at Beale Air Force Base in 2010, and joined a 2012 peace delegation to meet Pakistani survivors of U.S. drone attacks. She has repeatedly taken part in nonviolent actions at military bases. After an April 8, 2026 protest at Holloman Air Force Base, she spent two nights in custody and was released after arraignment; the charge was conditionally dismissed in May.
profiles.finding: Popular Resistance, Nuclear Resister and CovertAction contain named activism reporting. Portrait/action image inspection remains open; actor namesake rejected.
